You’re better in person, but today’s sales cycle confines you to digital communication. Record, send, and connect with BombBomb's simple video recorder. Stand out and get the attention you deserve with our **animated video previews.**

### TRACKING/

### The insights you need at the time and in the channels you choose.

Reach back out when you’re top of mind. Know exactly who’s opening, clicking, and playing - and exactly when. Go even deeper with enhanced video analytics.

### More control over your digital communication.

As a master of efficiency, you time block, making several emails and video emails in one sitting. Send each one out now or at its ideal day or time in the future.
